gloss: to get to know, to become acquainted

definitions.gloss: to get to know, to become acquainted
definitions.explanation: To meet and become familiar with someone; to form an acquaintance.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}で{彼|かれ}と{知|し}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I got to know him at university.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{仕事|しごと}を{通|とお}じて{知|し}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: The two of them got to know each other through work.

examples.japanese: {知|し}り{合|あ}ってからもう10{年|ねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been 10 years since we met.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xと{知|し}り{合|あ}う.

{知|し}り{合|あ}う is formed from {知|し}る (to know) + {合|あ}う (mutual action). The {合|あ}う suffix indicates both parties participate.

RELATED WORDS:
- {知|し}り{合|あ}い (acquaintance - noun form)
- {知|し}る (to know)
- {出会|であ}う (to meet, encounter)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～で{知|し}り{合|あ}う (to meet at ~)
- ～を{通|とお}じて{知|し}り{合|あ}う (to meet through ~)
- {知|し}り{合|あ}って～{年|ねん} (have known each other for ~ years)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {知|し}り{合|あ}う: to become acquainted (emphasis on getting to know)
- {出会|であ}う: to meet (initial encounter)
- {会|あ}う: to meet (general)
